text.en:
The Barangay Community Brigades consisting of the Barangay Volunteer Brigade, Barangay
Ladies Auxiliary Brigade, Barangay Disaster Brigade, Barangay Traffic Auxiliary Brigade, Barangay Tanod
Brigade such other Brigades as may be organized by the Governor of Metropolitan Manila are hereby
extended official recognition as such.
"Art. 152. Person in Authority and Agents of persons in Authority Who shall be deemed as such. In applying
the provisions of the preceding and other articles of this Code, any person directly vested with jurisdiction
whether as an individual or as a member of some court of government-owned or controlled corporation,
board, or commission, shall be deemed as person in authority.
"Any person who, by direct provision of law or by election or by appointment by competent authority, is
charged with the maintenance of public order and the protection and security of life and property, such as a
barangay councilman, barangay policeman, barangay leader, officers and members of the Barangay
Community Brigades, and any person who comes to the aid of person in authority. A barangay captain and/or
barangay chairman shall also be deemed a person in authority.
"In applying the provisions of Articles 148 and 151 of this Code, teachers, professors, and person charged
with the supervision of public or duly recognized private schools, colleges and universities, shall be deemed
persons in authority."

The Officers and members of the Barangay Community Brigades referred to in section 1 thereof
shall be extended insurance coverage in the form and extent to be determined jointly by the Secretary of Local
Government and Community development, Secretary of National Defense, Secretary of Finance, Governor of
the Metropolitan Manila and the General Manager of the Government Service and Insurance System who

shall promulgate rules and regulations on the matter.

All laws, decree, rules and regulations inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed, amended of
modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 7th day of November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
